title: Kenyan Beef Tripe Tacos
description: A unique fusion of Kenyan and Mexican flavors in this hearty beef tripe taco recipe. The tripe is slow-cooked in a rich, resinous tomato-based sauce.

ingredients.name: beef tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
ingredients.notes: depending on desired level of heat

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the tripe and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and chipotle peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato bisque, lime juice, and aerated water. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the tripe is tender, about 2 hours.
Shred the tripe with two forks and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the tripe mixture onto a tortilla and topping with your desired toppings.
